caption: The drawing depicts two identical mechanical objects, shown from slightly different angles, both oriented horizontally and positioned one above the other on a beige background. Each object consists of a metallic structure with multiple components: a gold-colored, curved lever arm extending to the left, ending in a round bulbous tip; a central, oval-shaped housing or body, which is gold with visible engravings or textured patterns; and several dark gray metal parts mounted atop the body, including a spring-loaded mechanism, a vertical prong, and a hinged flat plate or hammer raised at an angle. Each device stands on four short legs, also coated in a dark metallic tone. Additional smaller details, such as screws and joints, are present on each object. The drawing is realistic in style, with shadowing and highlights indicating a reflective, metallic surface. Near the bottom, underneath the lower object, the name "Stanley Mazur" is inscribed in small letters.
title: Flint Lock
